subject: Executive Offsite — Boardroom Telepresence Options / Readiness
messages_1_body:
Hi Ava and Marissa,

Thanks for considering Boardroom 3 at Hotel Meridian for your June offsite. We have two telepresence configurations that clients typically choose for executive meetings:

1) Native MTR package — room-based codec, dual pan-tilt-zoom (PTZ) cameras, beamforming mic array, and hardware codec. Reliable for large exec panels, simpler join flow for external partners.
2) Hybrid BYO + Producer — we provide cameras/mics and a technician; presenters join from their laptops into your tenant (Zoom/Teams). Better for mixed-host scenarios and for recording.

Quick questions to finalize an estimate:
- Expected headcount (onsite + remote seats)?
- Primary conferencing platform (Zoom, Teams, Google Meet)?
- Do you need recording + live captioning?
- Any preference for in-room monitor layout (single 98" center screen or dual side screens)?

I've attached a room diagram and estimated capacity. We can do an on-site AV walkthrough the Wednesday before the event.

Best,
Claire Park
Event Manager, Crescendo Venues
[attachment: Boardroom_Audio_Layout.png (image/png)]
messages_2_subject: Re: Executive Offsite — Boardroom Telepresence Options
messages_2_body:
Thanks Claire — quick answers inline: 
- Headcount: 18 onsite, ~6 remote observers (mixed time zones).
- Platform: Primarily Microsoft Teams (Acme will join from an MTR-equipped room + some laptop participants).
- Recording + captions: Yes, recording to our tenant and live captions required.
- Monitors: prefer single center 98" for focus, plus side confidence monitor for slide preview.

Needs and clarifications from our side: 
- We run our own MTR laptop as the primary bridge for session control. Can T1 supply an MTR-certified laptop and a backup MacBook with HDMI capture as fallback?
- Network: we require QoS or a dedicated guest VLAN for telepresence traffic + 5mbps/min per remote video stream. Our security team will also need an IP allowlist for the hardware codec endpoints.
- Latency SLO: ideally <180ms local loop to avoid awkward handoffs.

Ops@t1av, can you share a short AV rider and an option for on-site technician coverage window (arrival, pre-check, session, teardown)?

I'll schedule a vendor walkthrough for Wed 6/9 morning if that works.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0124
messages_3_subject: T1 AV — Rider and Technician Quote for Boardroom 3
messages_3_body:
Hi Ava / Claire —

Thanks for the details. Attached is our standard AV rider + an itemized quote for the MTR laptop + backup capture MacBook, dual PTZs, beamforming array, and single 98" monitor. We can provide a certified MTR laptop image and a spare capture device.

Proposed coverage: Technician onsite 3 hours before first session, 1 hour check between sessions, and 1 hour teardown. We also recommend a 30-minute dry run between 7:30–8:00am on the day-of with the remote Acme team to validate firewall traversal and captions.

Rider highlights (short):
- Power: dedicated circuit for AV rack (list included in PDF).
- Network: 2x wired ethernet drops (1 for systems, 1 for guest bridge).
- Recording: local USB passthrough to MTR laptop + optional stream to your tenant.

Attachments: T1_AV_rider.pdf (includes SOW and day-of rate card).

Regards,
Diego Ramos
Operations Lead, T1 AV Rentals
[attachment: T1_AV_rider.pdf (application/pdf)]
messages_4_subject: Re: Executive Offsite — Boardroom Telepresence Options
messages_4_body:
A few operational asks from CS side: 
- Please add a labelled run-of-show sheet with speaker order and expected slides per session; T1 needs that 48 hours in advance for camera presets.
- Network: I'll loop in our security engineer (Jonas) to provide the allowlist for the hardware endpoints and confirm the guest VLAN plan. Jonas — can you confirm the IP range we should hand to Crescendo?
- Travel: For the Redwood onsite attendees, travel will be coordinated through travel@redwoodinference.com. Ava, please let me know names and arrival windows for the 18 people so we can arrange pick-ups and hotel room blocks.

Also recommend we have a second onsite contact for day-of (someone who can approve quick spend for last-minute adapter purchases).

Thanks — Marissa
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
messages_5_subject: Re: Executive Offsite — Telepresence readiness & test window
messages_5_body:
Thanks all — consolidating next steps and ownership below (mutual action plan). Please confirm by EOD Friday so we can lock purchase orders and the walkthrough slot.

Mutual action plan (timeline):
- 6/04 EOD: Submit run-of-show doc + final attendee list (Owner: Marissa)
- 6/05: Security allowlist + guest VLAN details (Owner: Jonas)
- 6/09 09:00–10:00am: Vendor walkthrough at Hotel Meridian (Owner: Claire / Crescendo)
- 6/11 07:30–08:00am: Dry run w/ Acme remote room and MTR laptop (Owner: T1 Ops)
- Day-of 6/15 06:30am: Tech arrival / 07:00am: Setup lock / 08:00am: Doors open (Owner: T1 Ops / Crescendo)

Onsite POC: Ava Chen (mobile +1 (415) 555-0124) and Claire Park (Hotel Meridian). Secondary spend approver: Marissa Cole.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan.xlsx (agenda, run-of-show checklist, contact list).

Backup plans:
- If MTR hardware fails, switch to T1 capture laptop + cloud-recording.
- If network QoS not available, enable lane-priority on our VPN fallback and reduce outgoing frame rate to 720p for remote attendees.

Open items:
- Claire: please confirm whether the boardroom power panel has a dedicated 20A circuit or whether we need a stage power run.
- Diego (T1): confirm technician hourly rate for 6/15 and whether a spare PTZ is included in day rate.

Quotes and riders are attached; I'll route PO approval after confirmations.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth event.

Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
